## Santa Cruz in the Galápagos: giant tortoises and lava tunnels

Even neighboring parts of the [Galápagos Islands](/ecuador/place/galapagos-islands/) can have strikingly different natural environments. Northern Santa Cruz has dry landscapes, while farther uphill greener areas provide habitat for giant land tortoises. This Ada Tours excursion connects these environments in **6 hours**.

The route begins on [Baltra Island](/ecuador/place/baltra-island/), crosses the Itabaca Channel and then continues across [Santa Cruz Island](/ecuador/place/santa-cruz-island/) toward [Puerto Ayora](/ecuador/place/puerto-ayora/). The program includes observing tortoises in their natural habitat and walking through lava tunnels. **An English- or Spanish-speaking guide, transfer and lunch are included.**

## From Baltra across the Itabaca Channel

The excursion starts with a drive from the airport area on Baltra to the Itabaca Channel, which separates Baltra and Santa Cruz. The program allocates about **5 minutes** for crossing by motorboat, after which the trip continues in private transport.

The landscape changes noticeably along the way: the comparatively arid northern coast gives way to wetter, greener highlands. This makes Santa Cruz interesting for its terrestrial nature as well as its beaches and sea outings.

Arrival time, meeting arrangements and the order of stops should be coordinated with the flight. Ada Tours may change the sequence of visits if necessary.

## Giant tortoises in the Santa Cruz highlands

One of the excursion's main aims is to observe **giant Galápagos land tortoises** in their habitat. These animals are emblematic of the archipelago, but watching them in the wild differs from visiting a zoo: they move, rest and feed on their own terms and change location according to conditions.

The green highland areas of [Santa Cruz](/ecuador/place/santa-cruz-island/) are important to them. Maintain a safe distance, do not feed them and follow the guide's instructions. Do not approach too closely for a photograph or try to make a tortoise move.

Their size, shell shape and behavior are particularly worth observing. This excursion suits anyone interested in [watching wildlife](/interests/wildlife/) in natural habitats. The lava tunnels add another perspective on the island's [natural landscapes](/interests/nature/).

## Lava tunnels: how a volcanic island formed

The excursion includes **lava tunnels**, underground cavities left by molten lava flows. As the outer layer of a flow hardens, hotter material inside can continue moving; when it drains away, a tunnel can remain.

One section includes a **walk of about 30 minutes**. The ground inside can be uneven, dark and damp, so wear suitable shoes and follow your guide's instructions. Access requirements depend on the tunnels' condition and current regulations.

Combining the island's land-based highlands with volcanic cavities on one trip helps explain the origin of the archipelago's natural scenery.

## Price of the 6-hour excursion and extra costs

The standard excursion price is **$600**, while separate per-person rates apply to groups of different sizes.

| Group | Price |
|---|---|
| Base price | $600 |
| 2 people | $330 per person |
| 3 people | $240 per person |
| 4 people | $218 per person |

The English- or Spanish-speaking guide, transfer and lunch are included. **Paid separately** are the **$200 per person** Galápagos National Park entrance fee, the **$20 per person** transit card, personal expenses and medical insurance. These charges are listed under this excursion's terms; visitors should also confirm entry procedures and documentation under the current official requirements.

For a different island program, explore the [Floreana excursion from Santa Cruz](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/floreana-island-tour-from-santa-cruz/). It has a different route and its own price.

## Frequently asked questions about Santa Cruz Island

### How long does the excursion last?

The confirmed duration is **6 hours**. The approximately 5-minute Itabaca Channel crossing is part of the overall itinerary.

### Is national park admission included in the $600?

No. The excursion lists it among separately paid expenses, along with the transit card and insurance.

### Can I see both tortoises and lava tunnels in one trip?

Yes. Both are included in the 6-hour itinerary. Wildlife sightings depend on natural conditions, while access to the tunnels depends on current rules.

## Tours to Santa Cruz Island: tortoises, lava tunnels and the journey from Baltra

The [Galápagos Islands](/ecuador/place/galapagos-islands/) are known for giant land tortoises, marine animals and volcanic landscapes. If your journey starts at Baltra Airport, exploring the archipelago can conveniently continue on neighboring [Santa Cruz Island](/ecuador/place/santa-cruz-island/): crossing the Itabaca Channel opens the way to its lush highlands and the town of Puerto Ayora.

We offer a separate [6-hour Santa Cruz excursion](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/santa-cruz-island-tour/). It covers the crossing from Baltra through the Itabaca Channel, travel across the island, observing giant tortoises in the highlands and visiting lava tunnels. Guiding is in English or Spanish.

One example of a complete journey including this excursion is [“Ecuador, Galápagos and Humpback Whales”](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-humpback-whales/). Our 11-day group departure is scheduled for **August 11–21, 2027**. On day 5, **August 15**, the group flies to Baltra, crosses the Itabaca Channel, visits the Santa Cruz highlands and then continues to Puerto Ayora. This sequence makes it possible to use the arrival day for a first encounter with the island's wildlife.

## The Baltra – Santa Cruz – Puerto Ayora transfer

Baltra and Santa Cruz are separated by a narrow channel. On our tour, the transfer involves approximately **10 minutes by bus from the airport to the Itabaca Channel**, about **5 minutes by motorboat across the channel** and another **45 minutes across the island to Puerto Ayora**.

The scenery changes along the road: the drier northern areas give way to green highlands. These are habitats of land tortoises, one of the Galápagos' best-known animals. Whether a particular animal is visible depends on natural conditions; think of the observation as an encounter with wildlife, not a scheduled performance.

Another excursion element is the **lava tunnels**, formed as volcanic lava moved and cooled. Our itinerary allows about 30 minutes of walking through surviving sections. Wear stable shoes and be prepared for uneven ground and limited passage height in some areas.

After the excursion, guests check into accommodation in Puerto Ayora and have time for a walk on their own. On the 11-day tour, Santa Cruz is followed by boat excursions to Bartolomé and one of two possible routes, North Seymour or South Plaza, before a journey to Ecuador's mainland coast.

## What the separate excursion includes

The standalone [Santa Cruz excursion](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/santa-cruz-island-tour/) lasts **6 hours**. It includes transfers, lunch and an English- or Spanish-speaking guide. Rates vary with group size.

| Group size | Price as listed |
|---|---|
| Base rate | $600 |
| 2 people | $330 per person |
| 3 people | $240 per person |
| 4 people | $218 per person |

These are the terms for the separate excursion product. Different group sizes use different calculations, so the $600 figure must not automatically be treated as a per-person price for travelers on a multi-day tour.

The standalone excursion excludes **Galápagos National Park admission ($200 per person)**, a **transit card ($20 per person)**, personal expenses and medical insurance. These amounts appear in Ada Tours' commercial description; actual fee applicability and formalities must be confirmed for the chosen journey.

## Choosing a tour with Santa Cruz

For a first Galápagos journey, a program connecting Santa Cruz with other islands can be more rewarding than one that remains on a single island. On the [humpback whale tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-humpback-whales/), tortoises and lava tunnels are followed by sea excursions, then a return to the mainland and relaxation on the coast.

Travelers wishing to spend most of their journey at sea can compare [Galápagos cruises](/interests/cruises-and-expeditions/tours/ecuador/) and other [Ecuador tours](/ecuador/tour/). Cruises and land-based itineraries differ in overnight arrangements, transfer time and island stops. Santa Cruz is a convenient base, but having it in a route does not imply visits to every neighboring island.

Follow the area's established wildlife rules: keep your distance, do not feed animals, do not obstruct tortoises crossing paths and listen to your local guide. The Galápagos archipelago is a UNESCO World Heritage Site because of its exceptional wildlife and evolutionary history.

## Frequently asked questions about tours to Santa Cruz

### How long is the Santa Cruz excursion?

Our separate excursion lasts **6 hours**, including the journey across the island, tortoise habitats and lava tunnels.

### Is a separate transfer required from Baltra?

Yes. After landing, the route runs to the Itabaca Channel, crosses to Santa Cruz by motorboat and then continues by road to Puerto Ayora.

### Are tortoises found only on Santa Cruz?

Tortoises inhabit different parts of the Galápagos archipelago. On this particular excursion, the main tortoise-watching opportunity is in the Santa Cruz highlands.

### Is the excursion included in the humpback whale tour?

Day 5 of our 11-day itinerary includes the island's highlands, tortoise watching, lava tunnels and lunch. The separate excursion's commercial terms must be distinguished from the full multi-day tour's price.

## South Plaza Island: Galápagos sea lions, iguanas and birds

[South Plaza](/ecuador/place/south-plaza-island/) is a small island in the [Galápagos archipelago](/ecuador/place/galapagos-islands/) near the eastern tip of [Santa Cruz](/ecuador/place/santa-cruz-island/). It is known for open volcanic landscapes, reddish-green plants and animals that can be observed from relatively close range along permitted trails.

The Ada Tours excursion lasts **6 hours** and begins with a yacht departure from Santa Cruz. The sea crossing takes about **one and a half hours**.

## What makes South Plaza special?

As you approach, the contrast between dark rock, clear water and **Sesuvium** vegetation becomes apparent. Depending on the season, the plants may be green or reddish. Against the volcanic terrain, this creates scenery quite unlike that of the archipelago's larger forested islands.

After arrival, visitors follow a relatively easy trail. Sea lion colonies live here, as do land iguanas and different seabirds. Nature is the attraction: there are no major towns, hotel districts or urban sightseeing excursions on this island.

## Sea lions and land iguanas

Sea lions may lie on the beach, rest near the water or move around the rocks. Watching them is one of the island's principal experiences. But these animals remain wild: do not approach too closely, feed them or block their paths.

Land iguanas are well adapted to the island's dry landscape. They can remain motionless among rocks and plants, so watch your step and follow your nature guide's instructions.

In the more remote parts of the path, it becomes particularly clear that the Galápagos are a protected natural area where animal welfare comes first.

## Birds and cliff views

The trail leads to higher stretches of coastline. Here you can see sea cliffs, breaking waves and birds in flight. Local species include **swallow-tailed gulls, frigatebirds, blue-footed boobies and tropicbirds**.

Which birds appear depends on the time, weather and natural conditions; even a well-organized excursion cannot guarantee a complete list of sightings. Binoculars are useful for watching birds without approaching resting or nesting places.

Open areas can be exposed to strong sunshine and wind. Wear closed shoes with a stable sole and bring water, a hat and sun protection.

## What's included in the excursion

An **English- or Spanish-speaking guide, transfer and lunch** are included. A Russian-speaking guide is not listed for this product.

**The excursion costs $488.** These fees are paid separately:

| Additional fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Galápagos National Park entry | $200 per person |
| Galápagos transit card | $20 per person |

These are additional expenses; check official entry rules and fees with Galápagos authorities before traveling. The $488 excursion price and extra fees are separate budget items.

## Choosing a Galápagos excursion

South Plaza suits travelers especially interested in **watching wildlife and taking a short nature walk**. It does not promise diving, difficult trekking or an extensive cruise covering every island.

To explore different islands over more days, compare [Ecuador tours](/ecuador/tour/) and other [Galápagos excursions](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/).

## Frequently asked questions about South Plaza

### How long does the excursion last?

**6 hours**, including the sea trip and island walk. The yacht crossing is estimated at about one and a half hours.

### What language does the guide speak?

English and Spanish are confirmed.

### Is lunch included?

Yes. Lunch is included in the services.

### Are entrance fees included?

No. National park entry and the transit card are listed as separate charges.

### Can I see sea lions?

The island is known for sea lion colonies. However, their locations and behavior depend on natural conditions, so no specific sighting can be guaranteed.

## Tours to South Plaza: walking among sea lions and iguanas

The natural experiences on the [Galápagos Islands](/ecuador/place/galapagos-islands/) differ greatly from island to island. South Plaza, or Plaza Sur, lies near Santa Cruz's eastern coast. This small island is known for sea lion colonies, land iguanas, seabirds and Sesuvium plants that color the coastal slopes.

The [Ada Tours excursion to South Plaza](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/south-plaza-island-tour/) starts on Santa Cruz, then takes a yacht to the island in around **1.5 hours**. After landing, visitors walk among coastal animals and birds, and lunch is provided. The standalone excursion is listed as **6 hours**, with a price of **$488**.

On multi-day tours, however, South Plaza is often offered as **an alternative**, not a mandatory stop. This is essential when choosing: South Plaza appearing in a list of excursions does not mean travelers will visit both South Plaza and North Seymour.

## Where South Plaza appears in Ada Tours itineraries

On day 10 of the [11-day “Ecuador: Andes, Amazon and Galápagos” tour](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-islands/), **one of two sea excursions** is scheduled: North Seymour with Bachas Beach **or** South Plaza with Cape Carrión. The specific island is confirmed after booking; both excursions are not included simultaneously.

The same choice appears in the [17-day active tour through Ecuador and the Galápagos](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-adventure-17-days/). The island sea day offers 2 independent options, of which one is taken. When planning, confirm the itinerary for your departure rather than adding together all the listed alternatives.

Another example is [“Ecuador, Galápagos and Humpback Whales”](/ecuador/tour/ecuador-galapagos-humpback-whales/). Its sea excursion on **August 17, 2027** also offers a choice between North Seymour and South Plaza. The island portion of this journey is combined with Quito, Baños and later relaxation on the Pacific coast.

## Why visit South Plaza itself?

South Plaza is part of a volcanic archipelago that UNESCO recognizes as an exceptionally important natural area with endemic animal species. Excursion participants follow a designated or marked path, watching sea lions, land iguanas and birds from permitted distances. Red and green Sesuvium creates a distinctive color contrast with dark rocks and the ocean.

The canonical excursion description mentions swallow-tailed gulls, frigatebirds, boobies and tropicbirds. Different birds are present at different times; seeing every species in a single walk cannot be guaranteed. Higher ground offers views of surf and ocean. Binoculars are helpful, particularly when birds are far from the trail.

On some multi-day programs, the South Plaza option continues toward **Cape Carrión**, with lunch on the yacht, swimming and snorkeling. Check the specific Tour MD: the standalone South Plaza page describes a 6-hour walk and trip, while additional sea sections appear in particular multi-day itineraries.

## What's included in the standalone excursion, and what's extra?

The standalone “Plaza Island” product includes an English- or Spanish-speaking guide, transfer and lunch. Its stated price is **$488**.

The **$200 per person** Galápagos National Park entry and **$20 per person** transit card are listed as separate expenses. These figures come from the specific excursion description; do not transfer them to a multi-day package without checking its inclusions. Different tours may already include their own transfers and excursion days, while administrative charges need separate confirmation.

If you want to visit South Plaza, establish **which of the alternative sea excursions will actually take place** before booking. Do not assume a second excursion can be added without confirming available time, boat route and permits.

## Choosing a tour featuring the island you want

Compare islands by the main purpose of your journey. South Plaza is suited to visitors interested in sea lions, land iguanas, birds and contrasting scenery on a small island. North Seymour is a separate route in the programs, including Bachas Beach. These options have different geographic routes and stops.

In the full [Ecuador tour catalog](/ecuador/tour/) and [wildlife trips around Ecuador](/interests/wildlife/tours/ecuador/), compare trip duration, Galápagos days, accommodation and alternative boat routes. The word “Galápagos” on a tour cover does not tell you which islands will be visited.

## Frequently asked questions about South Plaza

### Can I visit South Plaza and North Seymour on the same day?

Our programs present these as **alternative itineraries** for one sea excursion day. By default, one chosen route is operated for each departure.

### How long is the standalone South Plaza excursion?

The excursion lasts **6 hours**, including the sea passage and island walk.

### Is lunch included?

Yes. Lunch is included in the standalone South Plaza excursion. On some multi-day programs, it is served aboard the yacht.

### When will the island be confirmed?

On tours with alternative sea excursions, the choice of South Plaza or North Seymour is confirmed after booking. It is best to clarify this when agreeing on the itinerary.

## Tortuga Bay and the Santa Cruz highlands: tortoises and a volcanic island

On the [Galápagos Islands](/ecuador/place/galapagos-islands/), natural conditions can vary considerably even within one island. This Ada Tours excursion combines the white-sand beaches of **Tortuga Bay** with the cool, humid highlands of **Santa Cruz**, home to giant land tortoises.

**Duration: 6 hours.** In addition to the beach, the route includes lava tunnels and the so-called Twin Craters. It is a good option for travelers who want to explore both the ocean shore and the interior of a volcanic island.

## Tortuga Bay: sand and coastal nature

The walk to the beach takes approximately **45 minutes**. The scenery gradually changes along the way before opening onto a wide expanse of white sand and coastline.

Tortuga Bay is known for coastal wildlife and birds, including marine iguanas. Individual sightings depend on time and environmental conditions. On Galápagos beaches, follow conservation rules, do not feed animals and keep the required distance.

There are places to relax by the water, but confirm which section is suitable for swimming and current sea safety conditions locally. Not every ocean-facing beach is equally safe to enter.

## Highlands and giant tortoises

Inland areas of [Santa Cruz](/ecuador/place/santa-cruz-island/) are more humid and have denser vegetation. They provide important habitat for giant land tortoises, which may move through grass and low plants.

It is especially interesting to observe their behavior without enclosures or an urban setting. Tortoises move slowly but remain wild. Do not approach too closely or stand in their way for a photograph.

The highland experience shows how native wildlife relates to the island environment. This contrasts with sea outings, where animals are viewed from boats and coastal trails.

## Lava tunnels and the Twin Craters

**Lava tunnels** formed as hot lava moved, the outer layer hardened and molten rock continued flowing inside. You will explore these tunnels accompanied by a naturalist.

The **Twin Craters** are two deep natural depressions on either side of the road. **Scalesia** forest grows in the area, associated with the damp highland environment. Walking here helps reveal the volcanic character of the island.

Sturdy athletic shoes with grippy soles and comfortable clothing are particularly useful for the tunnels. Anyone with difficulty walking on uneven ground should discuss the route and possible adaptations ahead of time.

## Prices and restrictions

An **English- or Spanish-speaking guide** and **transfer** are included. Lunch is not listed among the inclusions.

| Group | Price |
|---|---|
| Listed base rate | $660 |
| Group of 2 | $375 per person |
| Group of 3 | $278 per person |
| Group of 4 | $240 per person |

Additional expenses listed are Galápagos National Park entrance at **$200 per person**, the transit card at **$20 per person**, and a return flight to the archipelago **from $515 per person**. These amounts are not included in this program. The $660 base rate is kept separate from group prices because the conditions for its calculation were not specified.

## Choosing an archipelago itinerary

This excursion introduces the island's inland geography and large land animals. For frigatebird watching, explore [North Seymour](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/north-seymour-island-tour/); for sea lions and iguanas, consider [South Plaza](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/south-plaza-island-tour/).

More options are available in the [Galápagos excursion catalog](/ecuador/galapagos-islands/).

## Frequently asked questions about Tortuga Bay

### How long is the walk to the beach?

The published program estimates **about 45 minutes**.

### Are giant tortoise sightings guaranteed?

The Santa Cruz highlands are their natural habitat, but encounters with individual wild animals cannot be guaranteed.

### What language does the guide speak?

English or Spanish.

### Are flights to the Galápagos included?

No. Air travel is listed as an additional cost **from $515 per person**.
